xodo-revanced.description: Optimise business workflows with PDF fillable forms, smart annotations, and redaction features. This all-in-one document reader, editor and converter increases efficiency on mobile and tablet. Whether it’s to boost productivity at work or school: scan, edit, sign, annotate and convert documents with ease! Enhance PDF productivity and optimise business workflows with our advanced features, including fillable forms, smart annotations, and secure redaction tools for efficient document management.
